notes.note: Follow-up review of the final stream delta: /events overflow now includes the middleware cache families (integrations, skills, providers, scheduler jobs, knowledge) and Basis/update-state families. The canonical Session API precisely says the post-caught-up frame cap is that moment's remaining backlog plus 1024, with the continuing 8 MiB byte bound. Same-socket durable replay, per-subscriber authorization and the historical transport decision remain unchanged. Added real-socket 48 KiB-event pages prove the 1 MiB replay budget; injected missing scheduler resync and removed byte cap fail their named assertions. Physical devices, providers and production remain unverified.
